violated_contract: A create-only serving-index migration must start every missing composite index without waiting for prior builds, then verify readiness for the complete expected set within a budget sized for healthy large-collection builds. Serial blocking creates multiply per-index build latency, can time out the migration, and leave serving deployments blocked on a schema that is only partially provisioned.
canonical_prevention: Use asynchronous create operations for every missing composite, tolerate only an explicit ALREADY_EXISTS create response, and poll the complete expected signature set after all creates have been issued. Size both the readiness timeout and workflow job limit above observed large-collection build costs, and test the create-before-wait ordering, complete readiness set, and failure handling.
